slides.title: The Art Of The Prompt - A Guide For Everyone
content: Module 1: Introduction to Prompt Engineering
Episode 1: Crafting Effective Prompts
narration: Welcome to The Art Of The Prompt, Module 1, Episode 1. This tutorial helps you get useful answers from AI tools like chatbots. Asking the right questions saves you time and effort. Let's start learning how to create effective prompts.
slides.image_prompt: An abstract image representing the beginning of a learning journey with AI, perhaps a simplified glowing prompt box leading to diverse information, symbolizing effective communication with AI tools. The overall aesthetic should be clean and inviting.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
content: **Understand** key elements that make a prompt effective.
**Apply** clear and specific prompts for various tasks.
**Refine** basic prompts to improve AI output.
narration: After this tutorial, you will understand what makes an AI prompt effective. You will learn to apply clear and specific prompts for different tasks. You will also be able to refine your basic prompts to get better AI output.
slides.image_prompt: An abstract graphic illustrating three interconnected thought bubbles or gears, each labeled with an icon representing one of the learning objectives: a lightbulb for 'understand', a hand applying something for 'apply', and a magnifying glass for 'refine'. The design should be clean and convey a sense of progression.

slides.title: Prerequisites
content: Basic understanding of AI chatbots.
Ability to type messages into an AI interface.
narration: To follow this tutorial, you should know what an AI chatbot is. Also, you should be able to type a message into its interface. No advanced technical skills are needed to start this learning.
slides.image_prompt: A simple, friendly illustration of a person interacting with a chatbot interface on a screen, perhaps typing a message. The background should subtly suggest a basic, accessible computing environment. Focus on ease of use and familiarity with common digital tools.

slides.title: What is a Prompt?
content: A prompt is your instruction to an AI.
Clear prompts lead to better AI responses.
It helps the AI understand your intent.
narration: Imagine an AI like a helpful auto-rickshaw driver. Your prompt is like giving directions to him. If your directions are clear, you reach your destination easily. Similarly, a clear prompt helps the AI understand what you need. Let us see why this matters so much.
slides.image_prompt: Simple illustration of a person giving clear directions to an auto-rickshaw driver, with a thought bubble above the AI showing a correct destination. Labels: 'You = User', 'Auto-rickshaw driver = AI', 'Directions = Prompt', 'Destination = Output'.

slides.title: Be Clear and Specific
content: Vague prompts give vague answers.
Provide enough detail to the AI.
Think of 'who, what, where, when, why, how'.
narration: If you tell the driver 'Go somewhere nice,' you might end up anywhere. But with 'Take me to the railway station,' he understands perfectly. Similarly, always tell the AI exactly what you need. Provide specific details.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side illustration. Left: A confused auto-rickshaw driver with vague directions like 'Go somewhere nice'. Right: A confident auto-rickshaw driver with clear directions like 'Go to xyz railway station'. Show signs with 'Vague Prompt' vs 'Specific Prompt'.

slides.title: Be Specific: An Example
content: Weak: 'Summarize the news.'
Good: 'Summarize top three tech news from last 24 hours.'
Better: 'Summarize top three AI news from last 24 hours as bullet points.'
narration: Let's see this in action. A weak prompt gives a very general response. Adding details makes the AI output more relevant. Refining it with focus and format gives us exactly what we need. Observe how the output changes with added specificity.
slides.image_prompt: A placeholder image for a video slide. It should feature a stylized play button icon on a dark background, perhaps with a subtle graphic suggesting an AI chatbot interface behind it. The text 'Video Example' should be clearly visible.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of user opening an AI chatbot. First, typing 'Summarize the news' and observing general output. Second, typing 'Summarize the top three technology news headlines from the last 24 hours' and observing a concise tech summary. Third, typing 'Summarize the top three technology news headlines from the last 24 hours, focusing on artificial intelligence developments. Present them as bullet points' and showing three bullet points about recent AI news.

slides.title: Define Role and Format
content: Tell AI to act as a specific persona.
Specify how information should appear.
This guides the tone and organization.
narration: Now, let us use another analogy. Imagine instructing a chef. You can tell the chef to 'make a cake'. Or, tell the chef to 'Act as a bakery chef.' Then add 'make a cartoon cake for a child's birthday.' This defines the role and presentation. We can do the same with AI.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of a chef. Left: A generic chef receiving a vague instruction 'Make a cake'. Right: A happy chef in a decorated uniform receiving a specific instruction 'Act as a bakery chef, make a cartoon character chocolate cake for a child'. Show the difference in clarity and outcome.

slides.title: Role and Format: An Example
content: Basic: 'Explain photosynthesis.'
Intermediate: 'Act as a science teacher to a 5th grader.'
Advanced: 'Explain as a short story, under 150 words.'
narration: Observe how defining a role and format improves the AI's response. From a basic explanation, we get a simpler, engaging one for a child. Adding a word limit and story format shapes the output further. This helps get tailor-made responses.
slides.image_prompt: A placeholder image for a video slide. It should feature a stylized play button icon on a dark background, perhaps with a subtle graphic suggesting an AI chatbot interface behind it. The text 'Video Example' should be clearly visible.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of user in an AI chatbot. First, typing 'Explain photosynthesis' and showing a standard factual explanation. Second, typing 'Act as a science teacher explaining photosynthesis to a 5th-grade student' and showing a simpler, engaging explanation. Third, typing 'Act as a science teacher explaining photosynthesis to a 5th-grade student. Present the explanation as a short, easy-to-understand story, no more than 150 words' and showing a story-like explanation for a 5th grader within the word limit.

slides.title: Use Constraints and Examples
content: Add length or tone limits.
Provide an example style.
This further guides the AI output.
narration: Like a painter uses specific colors, add constraints to your prompt. You can limit length, specify a tone, or even provide an example. This helps the AI match your desired style and output more accurately.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of a painter with a canvas. The painter is holding a brush, and a color palette is visible. The canvas has guidelines or constraints drawn on it, representing length or style limits. The painter's tools represent the examples provided, showing how they refine the final artwork.

slides.title: Constraints and Examples: An Example
content: Basic: 'Write a poem about nature.'
Intermediate: 'Short, peaceful poem about a forest, four lines.'
Excellent: 'AABB rhyme scheme. Example: 'The sun shines bright, / A gentle light.''
narration: Let's see how constraints shape the output. From a general poem, we can get a specific four-line, peaceful one. Adding a rhyme scheme and example ensures AI follows your style. This brings great control to your prompting.
slides.image_prompt: A placeholder image for a video slide. It should feature a stylized play button icon on a dark background, perhaps with a subtle graphic suggesting an AI chatbot interface behind it. The text 'Video Example' should be clearly visible.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of user in an AI chatbot. First, typing 'Write a poem about nature' and showing a generic poem. Second, typing 'Write a short poem about a forest, in a peaceful tone, no more than four lines' and showing a brief, calming four-line poem. Third, typing 'Write a short poem about a forest, in a peaceful tone, no more than four lines. Ensure it has a rhyming AABB scheme. Example style: 'The sun shines bright, / A gentle light.'' and showing a four-line, peaceful, AABB rhyming poem about a forest, matching the example style.

slides.title: Iterate and Refine Your Prompt
content: Your first prompt may not be perfect.
Review AI output carefully.
Refine your prompt to improve results.
narration: Prompting is a dialogue, not a one-time instruction. Polishing a rough diamond takes time. Similarly, you might need to refine your prompt several times. Review the AI's first response. Then add details or modify instructions. This iterative process helps you get closer to your ideal output.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of a person looking at a rough diamond (first AI output) and then polishing it (refining prompt) to get a sparkling, perfect diamond (final AI output). Show arrows indicating the iterative process.

slides.title: Iterative Refinement: An Example
content: Prompt 1 (Initial): 'Give me birthday party ideas.'
Prompt 2 (Refined): Add '10-year-old, at home, no equipment, three ideas.'
Prompt 3 (Further Refined): Add 'encourage teamwork and creativity, not individual play.'
narration: See how an initial broad request can be narrowed down. Each refinement step guides the AI closer to the specific need. This shows the power of reviewing and iterating. It's like having a conversation to reach the best solution.
slides.image_prompt: A placeholder image for a video slide. It should feature a stylized play button icon on a dark background, perhaps with a subtle graphic suggesting an AI chatbot interface behind it. The text 'Video Example' should be clearly visible.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of user in an AI chatbot. First, typing 'Give me ideas for a birthday party' and showing generic ideas. Second, typing 'I need ideas for a 10-year-old's birthday party. The party will be at home, and I want activities that don't require much equipment. Give me three specific ideas.' and showing improved ideas. Third, typing 'I need ideas for a 10-year-old's birthday party. The party will be at home, and I want activities that don't require much equipment. Give me three specific ideas that encourage teamwork and creativity, not just individual play.' and showing excellent, specific, teamwork-oriented ideas.

slides.title: Summary
content: Be clear and specific in your prompts.
Define the AI's role and output format.
Use constraints and examples for guidance.
Iterate and refine your prompts for best results.
narration: In this tutorial, we learned how to write effective AI prompts. Always be clear and specific in your instructions. Define the AI's role and the output format. Use constraints and examples for better guidance. Finally, always iterate and refine your prompts. This ensures you get desired results.
slides.image_prompt: Simple infographic with four key icons: a magnifying glass for 'clear & specific', a mask for 'role & format', a ruler for 'constraints & examples', and a circular arrow for 'iterate & refine'. Each icon represents a key takeaway, arranged in a visually appealing flow.

slides.title: Assignment
content: **Task:** Create a comprehensive prompt for an AI chatbot.
Imagine planning a small garden.
Include AI's role, your goal, constraints, and output format.
narration: Here is a small assignment for you. Imagine you are planning a small garden and need AI advice. Create a single, comprehensive prompt for an AI chatbot. This prompt should define the AI's role and your goal. Also, include specific details, constraints, and the output format. Practice these skills.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of a person happily tending to a small, potted garden on a sunny balcony. A thought bubble above them shows a well-structured AI prompt related to gardening advice, highlighting clarity and specificity. Emphasize creativity and clear communication in the prompt creation.
